'''Vol Kolla''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rattataki/Legends|Rattataki]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] who worked as a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] for the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="TOR:SF" />

==Biography==
{{Quote|Lord Qet wants to save face, but secretly. He calls in me and my mercs. By the time we get here, the slaves have captured some giant industrial drills, and they're getting ready to bring down the whole giant statue.|Vol Kolla|<ref name="TOR:SF" />}}
Stationed on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], he and his team were assigned by [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Qet]] to stop a group of [[Dromund Kaas rebellion|rebel]] [[Dromund Kaas rebels|slaves]] that have gotten their hands on large mining drills and plan to use them to bring down the colossus. Kolla and his team completely failed and were forced to retreat from the [[Nalis Quarry]]. As an Imperial individual arrived, he asked the individual to take over his task by preventing the rebels from succeeding.<ref name="TOR:SF" />
